description: Read, write, or clear the one ephemeral per-project working-state note (§3.6, D89): where an interrupted task stands, so a fresh session can resume. Scratch state, NOT durable knowledge — it never enters memory retrieval or a review ladder; any conclusion here that should outlive the task goes through the normal memory_add/checkpoint-proposal path instead. WRITE it (action=write, content required) when the user signals the session or task is wrapping up — body rubric: task summary (one paragraph), open files, last commands, where the work stands, next step; short by design, a scratch note, not a transcript. READ it when resuming work or when the user asks what they were doing. CLEAR it on the user's request only. The note lives outside memories/, the user can edit the plain file directly, and it expires after ttl_days (default 7) — expired notes are ignored and `audit` reports them.

action.description: read = show the current note (empty when none); write = create or refresh it; clear = delete it.

content.description: Note body, Markdown, short by design (required for write). Rubric: task summary (one paragraph), open files, last commands, where the work stands, next step. A scratch note, not a transcript.

name: memory_workingstate
